title: Coupling characterization of setwise asymptotic stationarity
exact_target: Find the right coupling criterion for setwise asymptotic stationarity if the usual total-variation coupling criterion is too strong.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9900006 (AMR-098-0006). CC BY 4.0.

Hermann Thorisson, \emph{Some Open Probability Problems}, author preprint; original Universidad de Buenos Aires copy preserved in Internet Archive capture of 27 March 2024, Section 3, coupling definitions, p. 3, and Problem 3.2, p. 4.
